name: Principality of Elba (1814–1815)
description: A white field with a red diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with three gold bees.
history: Designed by Napoleon himself and hoisted at Portoferraio on 4 May 1814 when he landed to take up the sovereignty of Elba granted by the Treaty of Fontainebleau. It flew until his escape to France on 26 February 1815 and is still used as the flag of the island.

features.symbolism: the Napoleonic bee — industry and unity
